findings.summary: At narrow viewports, the catalog editor reverses the action buttons visually while keyboard focus follows their DOM order.
findings.fix: Remove flex-col-reverse so the stacked visual order matches the DOM order, or change the DOM order to match the intended visual order at narrow widths.

passed: The shared content-width and grid rules do not reorder elements or change DOM-based tab order.
No positive tabindex values or other CSS order utilities were found in the scoped pages.
The shared sidebar and page shell retain source order across their responsive layouts.
notes: Static source review only; focus visibility was not runtime-tested at different viewport sizes.
The catalog editor button-order finding predates and is unrelated to the width changes.
